summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for dispatchable generation, gas-turbine-adjacent equipment, balance-of-plant, and backup generation. The reference lane is anchored by GE Vernova as the obvious gas-power OEM. The discovery lane emphasizes companies with direct exposure to data-center backup generators, medium-voltage power systems, and emissions/process equipment for power generation. Evidence strength is mixed: generator and data-center demand is well supported for GNRC and POWL; CECO is a smaller, less obvious balance-of-plant/emissions-control candidate requiring order-level verification.
